name: Combustible Poison

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: Why should bombs get to have all the fun setting things on fire? You can add a combustible additive to an alchemical poison. If a creature fails its initial saving throw against the poison, it also takes 1d4 persistent,fire damage. If a creature is already taking persistent fire damage, it instead takes a –1 circumstance penalty to its initial saving throw against the poison.
